formula.expr: exact: hp * 100 <= maxHp * pct ; floor-half: hp <= floor(maxHp * pct / 100)
formula.source: src/field/pokemon.ts:2408 (getMaxHp); integer math, no float ratio

examples: Boost power when at most 33% HP

formula.expr: exact: hp * 100 >= maxHp * pct ; floor-half: hp >= floor(maxHp * pct / 100)
formula.source: src/field/pokemon.ts:2408 (getMaxHp); integer math, no float ratio

conditions.label: {who} has between {minPct}% and {maxPct}% HP

formula.expr: at-least(minPct) && at-most(maxPct), same rounding for both

conditions.label: {who} just dropped below {ratio} of max HP

formula.expr: exact: hp + damage >= maxHp * ratio && hp - calculateShellBellRecovery(pokemon) < maxHp * ratio ; floor-half: t = floor(maxHp * ratio); hp <= t && hp + damage > t
formula.source: src/data/abilities/ab-attrs.ts hpCrossedBelow (moved from PostDamageForceSwitchAbAttr.canApply); floor-half form from archetypes/berserk-on-threshold.ts. The Shell Bell term belongs to the exact form.

guards.label: Does not trigger when my own move (Belly Drum, Substitute, Curse, Pain Split) cost the HP
guards.why: Self-inflicted HP costs are not damage taken from a foe; triggering would be a bug.

guards.label: Does not trigger when the attacker's move already forces a switch (Dragon Tail, Circle Throw, Sky Drop)
guards.why: The move switches the Pokemon out itself before the ability would act.

formula.expr: other has a last move AND it is not [DRAGON_TAIL, CIRCLE_THROW] AND not (SKY_DROP with result OTHER)

guards.label: Does not trigger when the attacker's move is boosted by Sheer Force
guards.why: Sheer Force removes secondary effects, and this effect counts as one.

guards.label: Only triggers after the final hit of a multi-hit move
guards.why: Reacting to every strike of a multi-hit move would trigger early and repeatedly.

guards.label: Does not trigger once I have fainted
guards.why: A fainted Pokemon cannot change form or act; triggering would be a bug, not a design choice.
